profile.campus: Gallatin, Sumner County, Tennessee (Meta's Gallatin data center campus)
profile.address: Roundtree Drive, Sumner County, Middle Tennessee, Tennessee, 37066
profile.reading: This Meta data center building (building 3 of 3 mapped in the newer cluster) is part of Meta's Gallatin campus in Sumner County, Tennessee, northeast of Nashville. Facebook announced the project in August 2020 after a three-year site-selection effort involving the Gallatin Economic Development Agency, the Tennessee Department of Economic and Community Development, and the Tennessee Valley Authority; the initial building was reported at 982,000 square feet with an $800 million investment, citing the area's infrastructure, workforce, and community partnership. Meta's own announcement confirms the Gallatin data center went live on November 14, 2024, with total Tennessee investment since grown to more than $1.5 billion, more than 1,100 peak skilled-trade construction workers, and now more than 100 operational jobs. TVA initially committed to bringing 220 megawatts of new solar generation to support the project; Meta's current fact sheet describes a Meta-supported total of 530 megawatts of new renewable energy capacity added in Tennessee as the campus has grown, alongside the facility's standard commitments to 100% renewable electricity, LEED Gold certification, and roughly 80% less water use than an average data center. Meta reports more than $1.4 million in direct funding to local schools and nonprofits, including a $250,000 grant to the Gallatin Shalom Zone for restoration of a historic gymnasium, 30 acres of native pollinator habitat planted on-site, and a partnership with the Tennessee Environmental Council to install roughly 6,000 square feet of pollinator gardens across Sumner County middle schools. Meta does not publish a specific street address, current building count, or per-building square footage for individual Gallatin structures beyond the original 982,000-square-foot building reported at announcement; the address above is derived from reverse-geocoding this building's mapped coordinates, not from an operator-published source, and should be treated as approximate.

reading.body:
Meta's Gallatin campus went live in November 2024 on a 982,000-square-foot building announced in 2020. Meta does not publish the current building count, total campus square footage, or per-building megawatt capacity for Gallatin. The operator states the campus is supported by 530 megawatts of Meta-supported new renewable energy capacity added across Tennessee as the project has grown, but does not attribute a specific fraction of that total to this site, so the actual IT load that Gallatin draws remains unpublished.

The campus sits in Sumner County northeast of Nashville as part of a multi-year TVA and state economic-development recruitment. It holds LEED Gold certification and commits to 100% renewable electricity and roughly 80% less water use than an average data center. No tenant specifications or pricing are published.

Tennessee has mapped 24 data-center facilities with only 4 publishing megawatt figures totaling 12.13 MW in public operator spec pages. Gallatin does not appear in that published total, so its rank of 5th in the state reflects only the 530 MW of renewable energy commitments Meta has stated it is supporting statewide, not a confirmed IT load at this site.
